Comparing task-specific small language models against general-purpose and medical LLMs for clinical note extraction

screen.reason: The study evaluates a locally fine-tuned small language model (IT5) compared to larger LLMs for extracting endoscopic markers from clinical notes on a retrospective annotated dataset without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
